concerns.text: Task T010 bundles multiple distinct analytical deliverables (ANOVA, Tukey post‑hoc, chi‑square stability test, sensitivity sweep with Bonferroni correction, slope‑ratio computation, Precision@10 aggregation) into a single task. This exceeds the granularity expected for a single executable unit and may hinder deterministic implementation and testing. Consider splitting T010 into separate, focused tasks (e.g., T010‑A for ANOVA & Tukey, T010‑B for translation‑error stability, T010‑C for sensitivity sweep, T010‑D for slope‑ratio & precision analysis).
